name: 32817 · Orlando, FL
findings: ZIP 32817 (Orlando) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32817 (Orlando) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
